summary: fix(settings): stop the duplicate Glean page_load on full page loads
description:
Because:

* Glean recorded page_load with the full URL on each full page load, and the app also recorded it with the path.

This commit:

* Removes enableAutoPageLoadEvents from Glean.initialize, so the path-only app effects are the single source.
* Updates the glean init test and adds an App test for one pageLoad on first render.
* Adds a functional spec that checks the real Glean pings.

Closes FXA-15079
